name: TWINPULSE
tagline: A digital-twin dashboard of a building's energy, water, and waste flows across its lifecycle.
description: Models a building's energy, water, and waste flows as a live digital twin, scrubbable across its lifecycle timeline, with a Sankey diagram tracing grid/solar/BESS energy through transformers to chillers, IT load, and lifts, plus a whole-life CO2e figure and scenario comparison.

page.objective: Give a single live view of a building's resource flows across its whole lifecycle, not just at one point in time.
page.problem: Energy, water, and waste performance are usually reported separately and only at a single point in a building's life.
page.solution: A lifecycle timeline scrubber drives a live Sankey diagram of energy flow plus water/waste dashboards, with a whole-life CO2e figure and scenario comparison.

highlights.headline: A lifecycle-scrubbable digital twin of a building's energy, water, and waste flows.
points: Sankey diagram traces energy from Grid/Solar/BESS through transformers to chillers, server IT, and lifts.
Reports a whole-life CO2e figure alongside the flow diagrams.
Compares Reactive, Planned, and Best-practice scenarios against each other.
